caption: Lakšto plotis, ilgis, mm. Teorinis svoris (kg/lakštas).
notes: Units: first column = sheet thickness in mm; the other column labels are sheet formats, width x length in mm; cell values = theoretical mass in kg per sheet. Number formatting is mixed in the source and kept as printed: whole numbers without decimals (16, 25, 36 ...), fractional values with a dot and two decimals (19.20, 43.20, 37.50, 62.50). No footnotes, no empty cells. 6 body rows, 3 format columns, 18 filled value cells. Observation for the verification step (no value was changed): every printed weight equals exactly width x length x thickness x 8.0 kg per m2 per mm, i.e. the source uses a rounded density of 8000 kg/m3, about 1.9 % above a 7850 kg/m3 calculation.
